title: Malloc: the VPN that blocks spyware and hacking attempts
summary: Standard VPNs hide your IP but not every tracker. Malloc’s on-device VPN filters spyware, trackers and malicious connections before data leaves your phone.
body_markdown:
Worried that someone might be collecting your data or listening to you without your consent? Here’s how to stop it.


Did you know your phone connects to hundreds of hidden domains every day — even when you aren’t using it?


We tend to think of our phones as secure vaults that only work when we tap the screen. But the reality is much busier. In the background, your device is constantly sending and receiving data. While some of this “chatter” is necessary — like your email app checking for new messages or your weather widget updating the forecast — a significant portion of these connections are unwanted. They are often links to ad networks, third-party trackers, or even spyware attempting to collect information about your habits, location, and identity.


So, how do you distinguish the good connections from the bad? And more importantly, how do you stop the bad ones without breaking your apps?


Well, this is exactly what Malloc does.


## The Problem: Silent Data Leaks


Most standard VPNs route all your traffic through a remote server. While this hides your IP address, it doesn’t necessarily stop specific apps on your phone from “phoning home” to trackers.


Spyware and trackers often operate silently in the background, sending data packets before you even realize it. By the time you open an app, your data has often already left the device.


## The Solution: Malloc’s On-Device VPN


Malloc takes a different approach to privacy. We utilize an On-Device VPN.


Instead of sending your data to a remote server to be filtered, Malloc does the heavy lifting right there on your phone. It acts as a local shield, filtering traffic instantly.


Why does “On-Device” matter?


- **Speed:** Because the filtering happens locally, there is zero latency added by sending data to a cloud server first.
- **Privacy:** Your data stays on your phone. Malloc does not collect your browsing data — the filtering happens on the device.


## How It Works: Real-Time Blocking


Once activated, Malloc quietly monitors outgoing connection requests.


- **It Identifies:** It distinguishes between a legitimate app update and a request to a known spyware domain.
- **It Blocks:** It stops connections to ads, trackers, and malicious sites before the data leaves your device.
- **It Reports:** You get full visibility. Our dashboard shows you exactly which domains were blocked in real-time.


This gives you control. You aren’t just trusting that you are safe; you can actually see the protection in action.


## Beyond Local Protection: Encrypted Global Servers


We know that sometimes you need more than just tracker blocking — sometimes you need to mask your location or secure your traffic.


That’s why Malloc also offers encrypted VPN servers in multiple countries. If you want to encrypt your online traffic or appear to be browsing from a different part of the world, you can switch this feature on instantly. It’s the best of both worlds: local tracker blocking for device health, and encrypted tunneling for internet security.


## Your Data, Your Choice.


At Malloc, our philosophy is simple: no servers for filtering, and no data collection. Just real privacy.


Your phone contains your entire life. It’s time to stop it from broadcasting that life to strangers.


Ready to take control? Protect your phone from spyware and trackers the smart, secure way.[See how Malloc VPN works](https://www.mallocprivacy.com/vpn/) .
